_: Runtime libraries the compositions load, served from this folder instead of a CDN. url: exactly what build.mjs writes into index.html. file: the copy here. sha256 of the file (identical to the CDN's bytes and the npm package's). A render resolves url -> local bytes through scripts/vendor-offline.cjs (run it with scripts/render.mjs or runRender() in scripts/lib/vendor.mjs). iconSets: the SVG icon sets build.mjs used to curl from jsdelivr at build time (icon, logo and auto-logo beats), one JSON {name: svg text} per set, every value the package's icons/<name>.svg byte for byte.
